lines: Dasht-e-tanhai mein, aye jaan-e-jahaan, larzaan hain
couplets.en: In the desert of solitude, my beloved, they tremble.

lines: Dasht-e-tanhai mein, aye jaan-e-jahaan, larzaan hain
Teri aawaaz ke saaye, tere honton ke saraab
couplets.en: In the desert of solitude, my beloved, the shadows of your voice and the mirages of your lips tremble.

lines: Dasht-e-tanhai mein, doori ke khas-o-khaak tale
Khil rahe hain tere pehlu ke saman aur gulaab
couplets.en: In the desert of solitude, beneath the dry grass and dust of distance, the jasmine and roses of your embrace bloom.

lines: Dasht-e-tanhai mein
Apni khushboo mein sulagti hui
Apni khushboo mein sulagti hui
couplets.en: It smoulders in its own fragrance.

lines: Apni khushboo mein sulagti hui, maddham maddham
couplets.en: It smoulders softly in its own fragrance.

lines: Door ufuq paar, chamakti hui qatra qatra
Gir rahi hai teri dildaar nazar ki shabnam
couplets.en: Far beyond the horizon, the dew of your loving gaze falls, glinting drop by drop.

Dasht-e-tanhai mein

lines: Is qadar pyaar se, aye jaan-e-jahaan, rakha hai
Is qadar pyaar se, aye jaan-e-jahaan
couplets.en: With such tenderness, my beloved, it was laid there.

lines: Rakha hai is qadar pyaar se, aye jaan-e-jahaan
Dil ke rukhsaar pe is waqt teri yaad ne haath
couplets.en: So tenderly, my beloved, the memory of you has laid its hand on the cheek of my heart.

lines: Yun gumaan hota hai, garche hai abhi subh-e-firaaq
Dhal gaya
couplets.en: Though separation is still at dawn, it feels as if its day has already waned.
